title: dark-triage helpdesk
description: dark-triage tickets: open queue, priorities, assignment, flow and app health.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled')
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'In progress'
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'Waiting'

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: Open tickets (not Resolved or Canceled) with priority High or Critical.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') AND priority IN ('High', 'Critical')

panels.title: Unassigned
panels.description: Open tickets nobody is assigned to.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') AND assignee_id IS NULL

panels.title: Resolved, 7 days
panels.description: Resolved tickets last updated in the past 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'Resolved' AND updated::timestamptz > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(created::timestamptz)) FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled')

panels.title: App
panels.description: Blackbox probes of /api/health on the VIP (dark-triage, 10.2.11.105) and each node: 200 only when the app reaches its database (Patroni VIP 10.13.11.104).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'Critical') AS "Critical", count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'High') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'Medium') AS "Medium", count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'Low') AS "Low" FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Open') AS "Open", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In progress') AS "In progress", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Waiting') AS "Waiting" FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled')
SELECT service AS "Service", count(*) AS "Open" FROM tickets WHERE status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

SELECT coalesce(a.display_name, 'Unassigned') AS "Assignee", count(*) AS "Open" FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Open tickets
panels.description: Every open ticket, most urgent first, then oldest. Click a ticket number to open it in dark-triage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'DT-' || lpad(t.id::text, 3, '0') AS "Ticket", t.title AS "Subject", t.type AS "Type", t.priority AS "Priority", t.status AS "Status", t.service AS "Service", coalesce(r.display_name, t.requester) AS "Requested by", coalesce(a.display_name, 'Unassigned') AS "Assignee", extract(epoch FROM now() - t.created::timestamptz) AS "Age", t.updated::timestamptz AS "Updated" FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN users r ON r.id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, t.created

panels.title: Created and resolved per day
panels.description: Resolved = the last update of tickets that are Resolved now (the app keeps no resolve time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created::timestamptz, '1d', 0), count(*) AS "Created" FROM tickets WHERE $__timeFilter(created::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(updated::timestamptz, '1d', 0), count(*) AS "Resolved" FROM tickets WHERE status = 'Resolved' AND $__timeFilter(updated::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Open backlog
panels.description: Tickets open at the end of each day (same Resolved approximation).

targets.rawSql: SELECT d AS time, (SELECT count(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.created::timestamptz <= d + interval '1 day' AND NOT (t.status IN ('Resolved', 'Canceled') AND t.updated::timestamptz <= d + interval '1 day')) AS "Open" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') AS d ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Updates per day
panels.description: Comments by people and by bots (claude, qwen), and activity lines (assignment changes).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.created::timestamptz, '1d', 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.kind = 'comment' AND coalesce(u.is_bot, 0) = 0) AS "People", count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.kind = 'comment' AND u.is_bot = 1) AS "Bots", count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.kind = 'system') AS "Activity" FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Created by type
panels.description: Tickets created in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Issue') AS "Issue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Request') AS "Request", count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Change') AS "Change" FROM tickets WHERE $__timeFilter(created::timestamptz)

panels.title: Opened by
panels.description: Tickets created in the selected time range, per requester (bots included).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(r.display_name, t.requester) AS "Requester", count(*) AS "Tickets" FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN users r ON r.id = t.requester_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Resolved in the time range
panels.description: Age here is creation to now; the app keeps no resolve time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'DT-' || lpad(t.id::text, 3, '0') AS "Ticket", t.title AS "Subject", t.type AS "Type", t.priority AS "Priority", t.status AS "Status", t.service AS "Service", coalesce(r.display_name, t.requester) AS "Requested by", coalesce(a.display_name, 'Unassigned') AS "Assignee", extract(epoch FROM now() - t.created::timestamptz) AS "Age", t.updated::timestamptz AS "Updated" FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN users r ON r.id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.status = 'Resolved' AND $__timeFilter(t.updated::timestamptz) ORDER BY t.updated DESC

options.content: Data: dark-triage's Postgres database (read-only role `triage_grafana`). App: [http://dark-triage.lylat.space](http://dark-triage.lylat.space). Bots file tickets with `dt` (claude) and `lylat-triage` (qwen).
